sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: New school, new friends, new start!

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: read about Millie and her new classmates;
sentences.ipa: /rˈed əbˈaʊt mˈɪliː ænd hɜː njˈuː klˈɑːsmeɪts;/
sentences.meaning: 阅读关于米莉和她新同学的内容；

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: learn about other students from Class 1, Grade 7;
sentences.ipa: /lˈɜːn əbˈaʊt ˈʌðə stjˈuːdnts frɒm klˈɑːs wˈʌn, grˈeɪd sˈevən;/
sentences.meaning: 了解七年级1班的其他学生；

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: learn how to greet others and make new friends.
sentences.ipa: /lˈɜːn hˌaʊ tə grˈiːt ˈʌðəz ænd mˌeɪk njˈuː frˈendz./
sentences.meaning: 学会如何迎接他人 并交新朋友。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: This is our first day at a new school.
sentences.ipa: /ðˌɪs ɪz ˌaʊə fˈɜːst dˈeɪ æt ə njˈuː skˈuːl./
sentences.meaning: 这是我们在新学校的第一天。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Let’s meet some of the students and teachers at Sunshine Middle School, and learn how to greet others and introduce ourselves.
sentences.ipa: /lˈets mˈiːt sˌʌm ɒv ðə stjˈuːdnts ænd tˈiːtʃəz æt sˈʌnʃaɪn mˈɪdəl skˈuːl, ænd lˈɜːn hˌaʊ tə grˈiːt ˈʌðəz ænd ˌɪntrədjˈuːs aʊəsˈelvz./
sentences.meaning: 让我们认识阳光中学的一些学生和老师，并学习如何问候他人和介绍自己。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Here are some students from Class 1, Grade 7 and their English teacher, Mr Wu.
sentences.ipa: /hˈɪə ɑː sˌʌm stjˈuːdnts frɒm klˈɑːs wˈʌn, grˈeɪd sˈevən ænd ðeə ˈɪŋglɪʃ tˈiːtʃə, mˈɪstə wuː./
sentences.meaning: 这里有一些来自七年级1班的学生，以及他们的英语老师吴老师。

sentences.speaker: daniel
sentences.text: Hello, my name is Chen Dan, and Daniel is my English name.
sentences.ipa: /həlˈəʊ, maɪ nˈeɪm ɪz tʃən dæn, ænd dˈænjəl ɪz maɪ ˈɪŋglɪʃ nˈeɪm./
sentences.meaning: 你好，我叫陈丹，Daniel 是我的英文名。

sentences.speaker: amy
sentences.text: Hi, I'm Zhao Min. My English name is Amy.
sentences.ipa: /hˈaɪ, ˌaɪm dʒaʊ mɪn. mˌaɪ ˈɪŋglɪʃ nˈeɪm ɪz ˈeɪmiː./
sentences.meaning: 你好，我是赵敏。我的英文名是 Amy。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Please greet and introduce each other.
sentences.meaning: 请互相问候并作自我介绍。

sentences.speaker: kitty
sentences.text: Hi, my name is Zhang Ke. You can call me Kitty.
sentences.ipa: /hˈaɪ, maɪ nˈeɪm ɪz dʒɑːŋ kɜː. jˌuː kæn kˈɔːl mˌiː kˈɪtiː./
sentences.meaning: 你好，我叫张珂。你可以叫我 Kitty。

sentences.speaker: simon
sentences.text: Good morning. I'm Luo Yang. You can call me Simon.
sentences.ipa: /gˈʊd mˈɔːnɪŋ. ˌaɪm lwɔː jɑːŋ. jˌuː kæn kˈɔːl mˌiː saɪmən./
sentences.meaning: 早上好。我是罗阳。你可以叫我 Simon。

sentences.speaker: sandy
sentences.text: Hi, I'm Sandy. My Chinese name is Li Shanshan.
sentences.ipa: /hˈaɪ, ˌaɪm sˈændiː. mˌaɪ tʃˌaɪnˈiːz nˈeɪm ɪz liː ʃæn ʃæn./
sentences.meaning: 你好，我是 Sandy。我的中文名是李姗姗。

sentences.speaker: millie
sentences.text: Hello, I'm Wang Xinyue, and I go by Millie.
sentences.ipa: /həlˈəʊ, ˌaɪm wɑːŋ ʃɪn jweɪ, ænd ˌaɪ gˌəʊ baɪ mˈɪliː./
sentences.meaning: 你好，我是王欣悦，大家也叫我 Millie。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Greet your partner and then introduce yourself.
sentences.ipa: /grˈiːt jɔː pˈɑːtnə ænd ðˈen ˌɪntrədjˈuːs jɔːsˈelf./
sentences.meaning: 先向你的搭档问好，然后介绍自己。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.meaning: Millie 正在向 Sandy 问好。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Use the conversation below as a model.
sentences.ipa: /jˈuːz ðə kˌɒnvəsˈeɪʃən bɪlˈəʊ æz ə mˈɒdəl./

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: The sentences in the box may help you.
sentences.ipa: /ðə sˈentənsɪz ɪn ðə bˈɒks mˈeɪ hˈelp juː./
sentences.meaning: 方框里的句子可能会对你有所帮助。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: “Morning” is an informal way of saying “Good morning”.
sentences.ipa: /“mˈɔːnɪŋ” ɪz ən ɪnfˈɔːməl wˈeɪ ɒv sˈeɪɪŋ “gˈʊd mˈɔːnɪŋ”./

sentences.speaker: millie
sentences.meaning: 我是 Millie。你叫什么名字？

sentences.speaker: sandy
sentences.text: My name is Sandy. Nice to meet you!
sentences.ipa: /mˌaɪ nˈeɪm ɪz sˈændiː. nˈaɪs tə mˈiːt juː!/
sentences.meaning: 我叫 Sandy。很高兴认识你！

sentences.speaker: millie
sentences.text: Glad to meet you too! Which class are you in?
sentences.ipa: /glˈæd tə mˈiːt juː tˈuː! wˌɪtʃ klˈɑːs ɑː juː ˈɪn?/
sentences.meaning: 我也很高兴认识你！你在哪个班？

sentences.speaker: sandy
sentences.meaning: 我在七年级 1 班。你呢？

sentences.speaker: millie
sentences.text: Wow, we’re in the same class! Do you have any hobbies?
sentences.ipa: /wˈaʊ, wɪə ɪn ðə sˈeɪm klˈɑːs! dˈuː juː hæv ˈeniː hˈɒbiːz?/
sentences.meaning: 哇，我们在同一个班！你有什么爱好吗？

sentences.speaker: sandy
sentences.text: Yes, I like playing the piano. What about you?
sentences.ipa: /jˈes, ˌaɪ lˈaɪk plˈeɪɪŋ ðə pɪˈænəʊ. wˌɒt əbˈaʊt juː?/
sentences.meaning: 是的，我喜欢弹钢琴。你呢？

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Think of a different greeting and share it with your classmates.
sentences.ipa: /θˈɪŋk ɒv ə dˈɪfərənt grˈiːtɪŋ ænd ʃˈeə ɪt wɪð jɔː klˈɑːsmeɪts./
sentences.meaning: 想想不同的问候方式，与同学分享。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: What other greetings do you know?

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Millie is introducing herself and her new classmates at Sunshine Middle School.
sentences.ipa: /mˈɪliː ɪz ˌɪntrədjˈuːsɪŋ hɜːsˈelf ænd hɜː njˈuː klˈɑːsmeɪts æt sˈʌnʃaɪn mˈɪdəl skˈuːl./
sentences.meaning: 米莉在阳光中学校介绍她和新同学。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Before reading, think about the questions below.
sentences.ipa: /bɪfˈɔː rˈiːdɪŋ, θˈɪŋk əbˈaʊt ðə kwˈestʃənz bɪlˈəʊ./
sentences.meaning: 在阅读前，考虑下面的问题。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 1 What do you want to tell your new classmates about yourself?
sentences.ipa: /wˈʌn wˌɒt dˈuː juː wˈɒnt tə tˈel jɔː njˈuː klˈɑːsmeɪts əbˈaʊt jɔːsˈelf?/
sentences.meaning: 1，你对新同学自己有什么看法？。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 2 What do you know about your new classmates?
sentences.ipa: /tˈuː wˌɒt dˈuː juː nˈəʊ əbˈaʊt jɔː njˈuː klˈɑːsmeɪts?/

sentences.speaker: millie
sentences.text: I'm Millie, a new student at Sunshine Middle School.
sentences.ipa: /ˌaɪm mˈɪliː, ə njˈuː stjˈuːdnt æt sˈʌnʃaɪn mˈɪdəl skˈuːl./
sentences.meaning: 我是米莉 阳光中学的新学生

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: to introduce ourselves on the phone.
sentences.meaning: 在电话里介绍我们自己

sentences.speaker: millie
sentences.text: He is always full of energy.

sentences.speaker: millie
sentences.text: He often plays football after school.
sentences.meaning: 他经常在放学后踢足球。

sentences.speaker: millie
sentences.text: She likes music and she can play the piano well.
sentences.ipa: /ʃˌiː lˈaɪks mjˈuːzɪk ænd ʃiː kæn plˈeɪ ðə pɪˈænəʊ wˈel./
sentences.meaning: 她喜欢音乐她能弹好钢琴

sentences.speaker: millie
sentences.text: He is smart and always ready to help others.
sentences.ipa: /hˌiː ɪz smˈɑːt ænd ˈɔːlweɪz rˈediː tə hˈelp ˈʌðəz./
sentences.meaning: 他很聪明，随时愿意帮助别人。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: A Match the new students in Class 1, Grade 7 with their hobbies.
sentences.ipa: /ə mˈætʃ ðə njˈuː stjˈuːdnts ɪn klˈɑːs wˈʌn, grˈeɪd sˈevən wɪð ðeə hˈɒbiːz./
sentences.meaning: 将一年级的新生 与他们的爱好相匹配

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Write a T if a sentence is true or an F if it is false.
sentences.ipa: /rˈaɪt ə tˈiː ɪf ə sˈentəns ɪz trˈuː ɔː ən ˈef ɪf ɪt ɪz fˈɔːls./
sentences.meaning: 如果句子是真的，写个T，如果句子是假的，写一个F。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 4 Sandy is a tall, polite girl.
sentences.ipa: /fˈɔː sˈændiː ɪz ə tˈɔːl, pəlˈaɪt gˈɜːl./
sentences.meaning: 4桑迪是一个高大，有礼貌的女孩。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Complete his notes with the correct forms of the words and phrases in the box below.
sentences.ipa: /kəmplˈiːt hɪz nˈəʊts wɪð ðə kərˈekt fˈɔːmz ɒv ðə wˈɜːdz ænd frˈeɪzɪz ɪn ðə bˈɒks bɪlˈəʊ./
sentences.meaning: 用下面框中的文字和短语的正确形式来完成他的笔记。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: C Mr Wu is making some notes about his new students.
sentences.ipa: /sˈiː mˈɪstə wuː ɪz mˈeɪkɪŋ sˌʌm nˈəʊts əbˈaʊt hɪz njˈuː stjˈuːdnts./
sentences.meaning: C吴先生正在做一些关于他新生的笔记。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: She is interested in music, and she can play the piano well.
sentences.ipa: /ʃˌiː ɪz ˈɪntrɪstɪd ɪn mjˈuːzɪk, ænd ʃiː kæn plˈeɪ ðə pɪˈænəʊ wˈel./
sentences.meaning: 她对音乐感兴趣，而且她能弹好钢琴。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: My new students are all very nice.
sentences.ipa: /mˌaɪ njˈuː stjˈuːdnts ɑː ˈɔːl vˈeriː nˈaɪs./

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: You can write them in the following order.
sentences.ipa: /jˌuː kæn rˈaɪt ðˌem ɪn ðə fˈɒləʊɪŋ ˈɔːdə./

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: D Write some sentences about yourself or one of your classmates.
sentences.ipa: /dˈiː rˈaɪt sˌʌm sˈentənsɪz əbˈaʊt jɔːsˈelf ɔː wˈʌn ɒv jɔː klˈɑːsmeɪts./
sentences.meaning: D写一些关于你自己或你同学的句子。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Millie sends a message to her old friend Jenny about her new classmates.
sentences.ipa: /mˈɪliː sˈendz ə mˈesɪdʒ tə hɜː ˈəʊld frˈend dʒˈeniː əbˈaʊt hɜː njˈuː klˈɑːsmeɪts./
sentences.meaning: 米莉向她的老朋友珍妮传递了一条关于她新同学的信息。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Read the message and pay attention to the use of the verb be.
sentences.ipa: /rˈiːd ðə mˈesɪdʒ ænd pˈeɪ ətˈenʃən tə ðə jˈuːs ɒv ðə vˈɜːb bˈiː./
sentences.meaning: 阅读消息，注意动词的用法。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I am at Sunshine Middle School now.
sentences.ipa: /ˌaɪ əm æt sˈʌnʃaɪn mˈɪdəl skˈuːl nˈaʊ./

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Are you happy at your new school?
sentences.ipa: /ˌɑː juː hˈæpiː æt jɔː njˈuː skˈuːl?/

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: We use the simple present tense to talk about facts and states.
sentences.ipa: /wˌiː jˈuːz ðə sˈɪmpəl prˈezənt tˈens tə tˈɔːk əbˈaʊt fˈækts ænd stˈeɪts./
sentences.meaning: 我们用简单的现在的时态来谈论事实和国家。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: A Here are some pictures of Millie, her classmates and her teacher at the new school.
sentences.ipa: /ə hˈɪə ɑː sˌʌm pˈɪktʃəz ɒv mˈɪliː, hɜː klˈɑːsmeɪts ænd hɜː tˈiːtʃə æt ðə njˈuː skˈuːl./
sentences.meaning: 这里有一些米莉的照片，她的同学和她在新学校的老师。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Complete what they are saying with the correct forms of the verb be.
sentences.ipa: /kəmplˈiːt wˌɒt ðeɪ ɑː sˈeɪɪŋ wɪð ðə kərˈekt fˈɔːmz ɒv ðə vˈɜːb bˈiː./
sentences.meaning: 用动词的正确形式来完成他们所说的话。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I have some new friends now.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Complete their conversation with the correct forms of the verb be.
sentences.ipa: /kəmplˈiːt ðeə kˌɒnvəsˈeɪʃən wɪð ðə kərˈekt fˈɔːmz ɒv ðə vˈɜːb bˈiː./
sentences.meaning: 用动词的正确形式完成他们的谈话。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: B Millie is talking to her new friends.
sentences.ipa: /bˈiː mˈɪliː ɪz tˈɔːkɪŋ tə hɜː njˈuː frˈendz./
sentences.meaning: B米莉和她的新朋友说话了

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: C Talk with your partner about people and things in your new school, using the correct forms of the verb be.
sentences.ipa: /sˈiː tˈɔːk wɪð jɔː pˈɑːtnə əbˈaʊt pˈiːpəl ænd θˈɪŋz ɪn jɔː njˈuː skˈuːl, jˈuːzɪŋ ðə kərˈekt fˈɔːmz ɒv ðə vˈɜːb bˈiː./
sentences.meaning: C用动词的正确形式，与你的伙伴谈谈你新学校里的人和事物。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Pay attention to the sounds of the letters a, e, i, o and u.
sentences.ipa: /pˈeɪ ətˈenʃən tə ðə sˈaʊndz ɒv ðə lˈetəz ə, ˈiː, ˈaɪ, ˈəʊ ænd jˈuː/
sentences.meaning: 注意字母 a， e， i， o 和 u 的声音。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Then put each one into the correct sound group.
sentences.ipa: /ðˈen pˌʊt ˈiːtʃ wˈʌn ˈɪntuː ðə kərˈekt sˈaʊnd grˈuːp./
sentences.meaning: 然后把每个都放进正确的音组中。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Try to read the new words according to the sound of the word in the centre in each group.
sentences.ipa: /trˈaɪ tə rˈiːd ðə njˈuː wˈɜːdz əkˈɔːdɪŋ tə ðə sˈaʊnd ɒv ðə wˈɜːd ɪn ðə sˈentə ɪn ˈiːtʃ grˈuːp./
sentences.meaning: 尝试按照每组中中央的单词声调读取新词。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: B Look at the groups of words.
sentences.ipa: /bˈiː lˈʊk æt ðə grˈuːps ɒv wˈɜːdz./

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Pay attention to the sounds of the letters in bold.
sentences.ipa: /pˈeɪ ətˈenʃən tə ðə sˈaʊndz ɒv ðə lˈetəz ɪn bˈəʊld./
sentences.meaning: 注意用粗体表示字母的声音。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 2 My classmates are all very nice.
sentences.ipa: /tˈuː mˌaɪ klˈɑːsmeɪts ɑː ˈɔːl vˈeriː nˈaɪs./

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 3 Sandy likes listening to piano music.
sentences.ipa: /θrˈiː sˈændiː lˈaɪks lˈɪsənɪŋ tə pɪˈænəʊ mjˈuːzɪk./

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 4 Simon and Amy go to school by bike.
sentences.ipa: /fˈɔː saɪmən ænd ˈeɪmiː gˌəʊ tə skˈuːl baɪ bˈaɪk./

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 5 These students go home by bus.
sentences.ipa: /fˈaɪv ðˌiːz stjˈuːdnts gˌəʊ hˈəʊm baɪ bˈʌs./

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Circle the correct words in the table.
sentences.ipa: /sˈɜːkəl ðə kərˈekt wˈɜːdz ɪn ðə tˈeɪbəl./
sentences.meaning: 将表格中的正确字圆形。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: A Millie is writing about her new friends Kitty and Amy.
sentences.ipa: /ə mˈɪliː ɪz rˈaɪtɪŋ əbˈaʊt hɜː njˈuː frˈendz kˈɪtiː ænd ˈeɪmiː./
sentences.meaning: 一个米莉正在写她的新朋友Kitty和Amy

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.meaning: 我的名字是艾米。 爱美。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Listen to their conversation and complete the sentences below.
sentences.ipa: /lˈɪsən tə ðeə kˌɒnvəsˈeɪʃən ænd kəmplˈiːt ðə sˈentənsɪz bɪlˈəʊ./
sentences.meaning: 聆听他们的谈话，完成下面的句子。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: B Millie is showing her mum a photo of her new class.
sentences.ipa: /bˈiː mˈɪliː ɪz ʃˈəʊɪŋ hɜː mˈʌm ə fˈəʊtəʊ ɒv hɜː njˈuː klˈɑːs./
sentences.meaning: B米莉要给她妈妈看一张她新班级的照片

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Kitty and Amy are Millie’s new friends.
sentences.ipa: /kˈɪtiː ænd ˈeɪmiː ɑː mˈɪliːz njˈuː frˈendz./

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: She has dance classes every week.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Millie likes her new friends very much.
sentences.ipa: /mˈɪliː lˈaɪks hɜː njˈuː frˈendz vˈeriː mˈʌtʃ./
sentences.meaning: 米莉非常喜欢她的新朋友

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: C Millie and Ms Lin, the Music teacher, meet Simon in front of the classroom building.
sentences.ipa: /sˈiː mˈɪliː ænd, ðə mjˈuːzɪk tˈiːtʃə, mˈiːt saɪmən ɪn frˈʌnt ɒv ðə klˈɑːsruːm bˈɪldɪŋ./
sentences.meaning: C米莉和音乐老师林小姐在教室大楼前与西蒙会面。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Work in groups of three to greet and introduce each other.
sentences.ipa: /wˈɜːk ɪn grˈuːps ɒv θrˈiː tə grˈiːt ænd ˌɪntrədjˈuːs ˈiːtʃ ˈʌðə./
sentences.meaning: 分三组工作，互相问候和介绍。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Use the conversation below as a model.
sentences.ipa: /jˈuːz ðə kˌɒnvəsˈeɪʃən bɪlˈəʊ æz ə mˈɒdəl./

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: When we introduce two people to each other, we usually introduce the younger to the elder first.
sentences.ipa: /wˌen wiː ˌɪntrədjˈuːs tˈuː pˈiːpəl tʊ ˈiːtʃ ˈʌðə, wiː jˈuːʒʊəliː ˌɪntrədjˈuːs ðə jˈʌŋgə tə ðiː ˈeldə fˈɜːst./
sentences.meaning: 当我们向对方介绍两个人时，通常先向长者介绍年幼者。

sentences.speaker: millie
sentences.text: Hi, Simon. Ms Lin, this is my classmate Simon. Simon, this is Ms Lin, our Music teacher.
sentences.ipa: /hˈaɪ, saɪmən., ðɪs ɪz maɪ klˈɑːsmeɪt saɪmən. saɪmən, ðɪs ɪz, ˌaʊə mjˈuːzɪk tˈiːtʃə./
sentences.meaning: 嗨，Simon，Lin女士，这是我的同学Simon，Simon，这是Lin女士，我们的音乐老师

sentences.speaker: simon
sentences.text: Glad to meet you, Ms Lin.
sentences.meaning: 很高兴见到你 林小姐

sentences.speaker: ms lin
sentences.text: Glad to meet you too, Simon. You like playing football, right?
sentences.ipa: /glˈæd tə mˈiːt juː tˈuː, saɪmən. jˌuː lˈaɪk plˈeɪɪŋ fˈʊtbɔːl, rˈaɪt?/
sentences.meaning: 很高兴见到你，西蒙你喜欢踢足球，对吧？

sentences.speaker: simon
sentences.text: Yes, I do. I often play football after school. Sport helps me stay healthy and happy.
sentences.ipa: /jˈes, ˌaɪ dˈuː. ˌaɪ ˈɒfən plˈeɪ fˈʊtbɔːl ˈɑːftə skˈuːl. spˈɔːt hˈelps mˌiː stˈeɪ hˈelθiː ænd hˈæpiː./
sentences.meaning: 是的，我放学后经常打橄榄球 运动能帮助我保持健康和快乐

sentences.speaker: simon
sentences.text: Oh, we have a football match with Class 2 at 4:30 this afternoon. I have to go now. Goodbye, Ms Lin. Goodbye, Millie.
sentences.ipa: /ˈəʊ, wiː hæv ə fˈʊtbɔːl mˈætʃ wɪð klˈɑːs tˈuː æt fˈɔː θˈɜːtiː ðɪs ˌɑːftənˈuːn. ˌaɪ hæv tə gˌəʊ nˈaʊ. gʊdbˈaɪ,. gʊdbˈaɪ, mˈɪliː./
sentences.meaning: 今天下午4: 30，我们和二年级的足球比赛，我得走了，再见，林小姐，再见，米莉

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: D To help students learn more about each other, Mr Wu asked every student to write a self-introduction and post it on the school website.
sentences.ipa: /dˈiː tə hˈelp stjˈuːdnts lˈɜːn mˈɔː əbˈaʊt ˈiːtʃ ˈʌðə, mˈɪstə wuː ˈɑːskt ˈevəriː stjˈuːdnt tə rˈaɪt ə sˌelfˌɪntrədˈʌkʃən ænd pˈəʊst ɪt ˌɒn ðə skˈuːl wˈebsaɪt./
sentences.meaning: D为了帮助学生更多地了解对方，吴先生要求每个学生写一个自我介绍，并张贴到学校网站上。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Complete the table with your own information.
sentences.ipa: /kəmplˈiːt ðə tˈeɪbəl wɪð jɔː ˈəʊn ˌɪnfəmˈeɪʃən./
sentences.meaning: 使用您自己的信息填写表格 。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: D1 Daniel is making a table to help him write the self-introduction.
sentences.ipa: /dˈiː wˈʌn dˈænjəl ɪz mˈeɪkɪŋ ə tˈeɪbəl tə hˈelp hˌɪm rˈaɪt ðə sˌelfˌɪntrədˈʌkʃən./
sentences.meaning: D1丹尼尔正在做一个桌子 帮助他写自我介绍。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I am Chen Dan from Class 1, Grade 7.
sentences.ipa: /ˌaɪ æm tʃən dæn frɒm klˈɑːs wˈʌn, grˈeɪd sˈevən./
sentences.meaning: 我是一年级的陈丹，七年级的

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: My favourite subjects are Maths and Computer Science.
sentences.ipa: /mˌaɪ fˈeɪvərɪt sˈʌbdʒekts ɑː mˈæθs ænd kəmpjˈuːtə sˈaɪəns./
sentences.meaning: 我最喜欢的科目是数学和计算机科学。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I am good at them, and I like to help my classmates with Maths problems.
sentences.ipa: /ˌaɪ əm gˈʊd æt ðˌem, ænd ˌaɪ lˈaɪk tə hˈelp maɪ klˈɑːsmeɪts wɪð mˈæθs prˈɒbləmz./
sentences.meaning: 我擅长数学，我喜欢帮助我的同学 解决数学问题。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I enjoy playing Chinese chess and ping-pong.
sentences.ipa: /ˌaɪ ɪndʒˈɔɪ plˈeɪɪŋ tʃˌaɪnˈiːz tʃˈes ænd pˈɪŋpɒŋ./
sentences.meaning: 我喜欢玩中国象棋和乒乓球。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I often play these with my dad at the weekend.
sentences.ipa: /ˌaɪ ˈɒfən plˈeɪ ðiːz wɪð maɪ dˈæd æt ðə wˌiːkˈend./
sentences.meaning: 我周末经常跟我爸玩这些

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I have many new classmates at school.
sentences.ipa: /ˌaɪ hæv mˈeniː njˈuː klˈɑːsmeɪts æt skˈuːl./
sentences.meaning: 我在学校有很多新同学

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I am happy to make friends with them.
sentences.ipa: /ˌaɪ əm hˈæpiː tə mˌeɪk frˈendz wɪð ðˌem./
sentences.meaning: 我很高兴和他们交朋友。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Do you want to be my friend?
sentences.ipa: /dˈuː juː wˈɒnt tə biː maɪ frˈend?/

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: We use a comma (,) to pause or separate things in a sentence.
sentences.ipa: /wˌiː jˈuːz ə kˈɒmə (,) tə pˈɔːz ɔː sˈepərət θˈɪŋz ɪn ə sˈentəns./
sentences.meaning: 我们用逗号(，)在句子中暂停或分离事物。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: at the end of a question.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Use Daniel’s self-introduction as a model.
sentences.meaning: 以丹尼尔的自我介绍为榜样。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: D3 Write your own self-introduction based on your information in Part D1.
sentences.ipa: /dˈiː θrˈiː rˈaɪt jɔː ˈəʊn sˌelfˌɪntrədˈʌkʃən bˈeɪst ˌɒn jɔː ˌɪnfəmˈeɪʃən ɪn pˈɑːt dˈiː wˈʌn./
sentences.meaning: D3根据您在D1部分中的信息，写出你自己的自我介绍。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.meaning: 我喜欢/喜欢数学/计算机科学/。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 1 I can describe Millie and her new classmates.
sentences.ipa: /wˈʌn ˌaɪ kæn dɪskrˈaɪb mˈɪliː ænd hɜː njˈuː klˈɑːsmeɪts./
sentences.meaning: 1，我可以描述米莉和她的新同学。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 2 I can use the verb be in the simple present tense correctly.
sentences.ipa: /tˈuː ˌaɪ kæn jˈuːz ðə vˈɜːb biː ɪn ðə sˈɪmpəl prˈezənt tˈens kərˈektliː./
sentences.meaning: 2，我可以使用动词在简单的当前时态正确。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 3 I can introduce myself and my classmates with the new words in this unit.
sentences.ipa: /θrˈiː ˌaɪ kæn ˌɪntrədjˈuːs maɪsˈelf ænd maɪ klˈɑːsmeɪts wɪð ðə njˈuː wˈɜːdz ɪn ðɪs jˈuːnɪt./
sentences.meaning: 3，我可以用这个单位的新字来介绍我自己和同学。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 5 I know how to greet others and make new friends at a new school.
sentences.ipa: /fˈaɪv ˌaɪ nˈəʊ hˌaʊ tə grˈiːt ˈʌðəz ænd mˌeɪk njˈuː frˈendz æt ə njˈuː skˈuːl./
sentences.meaning: 5，我知道如何迎接他人，在新学校交新朋友。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: * Assess your learning of new words and grammar by doing the exercises on page 106.
sentences.ipa: /əsˈes jɔː lˈɜːnɪŋ ɒv njˈuː wˈɜːdz ænd grˈæmə baɪ dˈuːɪŋ ðiː ˈeksəsaɪzɪz ˌɒn pˈeɪdʒ wˈʌn hˈʌndrəd sˈɪks./
sentences.meaning: *通过第106页上的练习来评估你对新词和语法的学习。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I need to spend more time on.
sentences.ipa: /ˌaɪ nˈiːd tə spˈend mˈɔː tˈaɪm ˌɒn./

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Don’t use a nickname if the person does not ask you to.
sentences.ipa: /dˈəʊnt jˈuːz ə nˈɪkneɪm ɪf ðə pˈɜːsən dˈʌz nˌɒt ˈɑːsk juː tuː./
sentences.meaning: 如果当事人不要求您使用昵称，请不要使用此昵称 。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Simon has a friend called William Smith.
sentences.ipa: /saɪmən hæz ə frˈend kˈɔːld wˈɪljəm smˈɪθ./
sentences.meaning: 西蒙有一个朋友叫威廉·史密斯。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: His parents and friends often call him “Will”.
sentences.ipa: /hˌɪz pˈeərənts ænd frˈendz ˈɒfən kˈɔːl hˌɪm “wˈɪl”./
sentences.meaning: 他的父母和朋友经常叫他“Will”。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Here are some nicknames for popular English names.
sentences.ipa: /hˈɪə ɑː sˌʌm nˈɪkneɪmz fɔː pˈɒpjʊlə ˈɪŋglɪʃ nˈeɪmz./
sentences.meaning: 这里有一些流行的英文名字的昵称。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Find out more fun facts about names and share them with your classmates.
sentences.ipa: /fˈaɪnd ˈaʊt mˈɔː fˈʌn fˈækts əbˈaʊt nˈeɪmz ænd ʃˈeə ðˌem wɪð jɔː klˈɑːsmeɪts./
sentences.meaning: 找出更多关于名字的有趣事实，并与同学分享。
